title: glyceria distans subsp. parlatorei
intro: Glyceria distans subsp. parlatorei, commonly known as the Manna grass, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as lowering blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Manna grass include acting as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic, which helps in soothing muscle spasms, reducing inflammation, and promoting urine production. The bioactive constituents of Glyceria distans subsp. parlatorei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
